name: Thread-Edge Flying Sword (Ti Nhận Phi Kiếm)

arts.name: Thread-Edge Cut (Ti Nhận Trảm)
arts.rule: A quick flying-sword cut that lays 1 Metal debuff stack for 6 s.

lore: A sword thin as a hair, forged in bulk for the outer disciples of sword sects.
build_use: The Thousand Cuts: a cheap, quick Metal-debuff cut that fills the first extra slots before better flying swords arrive.

name: Whetted Edge Ring (Ma Phong Giới)
lore: A steel band sharpened on one side; sword disciples joke that it cuts the finger that wears it.
build_use: The Thousand Cuts: an early ring for the crit loop, a little linh lực back on each crit.

name: Twin-Edge Flying Sword (Song Nhận Phi Kiếm)

arts.name: Twin-Edge Return (Song Nhận Hồi)
arts.rule: A flying sword cuts out and back: a Metal hit that lays 1 Bleed stack. A critical hit lays 2 more Bleed stacks for 5 s.

lore: One blade cuts going out and the other coming home, so the foe is never cut only once.
build_use: The Thousand Cuts and the Afterimage Sword Canon: crits lay Bleed, which Phantom Sword, Flying Sword and Triple Draw read as an alternate key; Opening Cut adds Bleed on every Physical crit.

name: Edge-Hiding Robe (Tàng Nhận Đạo Bào)

wards.name: Edge-Hiding Veil (Tàng Nhận Sa)
wards.notes: The Common Ward at 1.2 times its payload and its drain, so the price check is unchanged (3.049 of 3.050)

lore: Sword sects dress their disciples in grey robes so wide that no one can tell which sleeve holds the blade.
build_use: The Thousand Cuts: the Common Ward the build wants, a little stronger, with evade and thần thức left over for more swords.

name: Sword-Intent Jade (Kiếm Ý Bội)

reserve_arts.name: Sword Intent Aura (Kiếm Ý Quang)
reserve_arts.rule: While reserved, your sword arts are 8 % faster and deal 6 % more.
reserve_arts.notes: Priced by Formulas I reserve arts: 10 % reserved buys up to 10 W (8.8 W)

lore: Jade cut from a sword-tomb, where the dead left their intent in the stone.
build_use: The Thousand Cuts: Metal debuff piles that last longer and bite harder, with the swords' speed paid in reserved linh lực, not an art slot.

name: Rain-Calling Flying Sword (Hoán Vũ Phi Kiếm)

arts.name: Sword Rain Descends (Kiếm Vũ Giáng)
arts.rule: Counts as an Afterimage Sword Canon art. A quick Metal cut that lays 1 Metal debuff stack for 6 s; each of its hits leaves an Afterimage (twice a pulse at most). With 5 Afterimages, and either two canon arts fired in the last 2 s or 3 Bleed on the foe, the sword calls the rain: it spends the Afterimages and becomes four cuts of 3 times the force.

lore: Its tassel is cut from the rope that once bound a thousand swords in a sect's armoury, and they still answer to it.
build_use: The Afterimage Sword Canon and The Sword Hall: a fifth suite art that Phantom Sword, Flying Sword and Triple Draw count, and a payoff of its own when the Afterimages pile up.

name: Sword-Nest Flag (Kiếm Sào Kỳ)

effects.name: Sword Chorus (Kiếm Hợp Minh)
effects.rule: Your sword artifact arts deal 6 % more for each other equipped artifact that gives you a sword art, with no cap.
effects.reads: Equipped artifacts carrying a sword art, at equip
effects.payload: damage_more on sword artifact arts, per other sword artifact
effects.closes: Your arts that are not sword arts deal 15 % less.
effects.from: new (The Sword Hall: several flying swords in extra slots)
effects.status: accepted for now (user, 2026-11-12); not yet in effects.md

lore: A grey flag that hangs in the sword-hall rafters; each blade hung beneath it sings with the others.
build_use: The Sword Hall (Kiếm Các), a new build: a sword cultivator who wears Flying Swords in every extra slot, and each added sword makes all of them hit harder; the flag takes a utility slot and holds the chorus together.

name: Tortoise-Edge Armour (Quy Nhận Giáp)

wards.name: Tortoise-Edge Shell (Quy Nhận Xác)
wards.notes: The starter shell at 2 times its payload and its cast cost, so the price check is unchanged (4.711 of 4.766)

lore: Plates ground from a tortoise-shell hall where sword sects tested their blades and the shell won.
build_use: Blood on the Whetstone: Physical foes break on the shell, and every Physical art fired gives the body shield back a little.

name: Thousand-Cut Returning Sword (Thiên Trảm Hồi Kiếm)

arts.name: Thousand-Cut Return (Thiên Trảm Hồi)
arts.rule: A Metal cut that lays 3 Metal debuff stacks for 6 s; each hit leaves an Afterimage. With 15 Metal debuff stacks on the foe, and either 3 Afterimages or two Afterimage Sword Canon arts fired in the last second, the sword gathers every cut: it spends 10 of the stacks and falls 4 times as hard.

holder: An elder of a sword sect at Core Formation or above; otherwise Lost in a sword-tomb that no sect has opened
lore: It was thrown a thousand times at one mountain and came back a thousand times; the mountain has a new gorge.
build_use: The Thousand Cuts: the keystone sword; the debuff pile is its fuel and its payoff, and the cut it lands turns the hundredth hit into the heaviest.

name: Ring of Unbroken Edges (Bất Đoạn Nhận Giới)

effects.name: Lingering Afterimage (Dư Ảnh Bất Tán)
effects.rule: Your Blade counters (Afterimages, Coils) do not decay.
effects.payload: Blade counters keep their count until spent
effects.from: new (The Sword Hall: banking Afterimages across a long fight)
effects.status: accepted for now (user, 2026-11-12); not yet in effects.md

reserve_arts.name: Unbroken Edge Aura (Bất Đoạn Nhận Quang)
reserve_arts.rule: While reserved, your sword arts crit 8 % more often and are 12 % faster.
reserve_arts.notes: Priced by Formulas I reserve arts: 15 % reserved buys up to 15 W (10.1 W)

holder: A Nascent Soul sword cultivator who has not lost a duel in a century; otherwise Lost in the ruins of a sword sect
lore: A ring forged from the last fragment of a sword that was broken once and never again.
build_use: The Sword Hall and the Afterimage Sword Canon: Afterimages and Coils are never lost between cuts, so slow engines bank to their biggest step.

name: Mirror-Trace Flying Sword (Kính Ngấn Phi Kiếm)

arts.name: Mirror-Trace Cut (Kính Ngấn Trảm)
arts.rule: A quick Metal cut that polishes the air into a mirror. A critical hit leaves 3 Afterimages.

notes: Answers: unique-unbroken-edge-ring: a way to bank Afterimages faster on crit, beyond Phantom Sword. Plain modifiers about 21.7 W of the 25.6 W grade 2 budget.
lore: Its flat is polished so true that every cut that lands leaves a second blade hanging in the air.
build_use: The Afterimage Sword Canon and The Sword Hall: a crit banks 3 Afterimages, which Sword Rain and the Thousand-Cut Return spend.
